name: terrenalv

scripts.//build: NOT --turbopack. The Turbopack build does not trace sharp's native platform package into the serverless function, so every payment-proof upload failed with 'Could not load the sharp module using the linux-x64 runtime'. The webpack build traces it automatically — verified in route.js.nft.json, which lists 74 sharp files and the platform's @img binary. Dev keeps Turbopack; nothing is traced there.

//optionalDependencies: sharp ships its codec as per-platform packages. npm resolved them into the lockfile on Windows but never installed the linux ones on Vercel — and once a build cache existed, every later install said 'up to date' and skipped them, so payment-proof uploads 500'd with 'Could not load the sharp module using the linux-x64 runtime'. Declaring them DIRECTLY forces the install on linux; the os/cpu fields make npm skip them everywhere else, so Windows/macOS dev is unaffected. Keep the versions in step with sharp.
